our_interpretation: The sentence gives no start date for the cumulative total. A later post (2025-03-03) speaks of 'over $200 billion of capital expenditures since 2023', but that is a different statement.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Microsoft's capital expenditures from the speaker's start date to the end of 2025 did not exceed $200 billion, on the measure he meant.
